description: Period-over-period percentage change for an indicator. Use for growth rates (YoY, QoQ, MoM) | "how fast did German GDP grow", "what is US CPI doing month over month". Runs on any verified autario indicator (World Bank, FRED, Eurostat, OECD, IMF, WHO, ECB, US Census, SEC).

full.description: Return the full raw time series (heavy, many tokens). Default false → you get only the summary/stats, which is enough to ANSWER a question. Set true only when you must plot or export every point.

name: pct_change
